# WFX Screen Registry. One entry per screen or destination the assistant may link to. Only APP ROUTE (a page of this platform),
# EXTERNAL URL (a verified outside link) and WFX URL (the live WFX screen, when known) are ever used as links; nothing else is navigable.
# WFX MENU PATH is how the screen is reached inside WFX itself. Generated by backend/scripts/build-registry.ts; edit freely, edits are kept.
================================================================================
SCREEN ID: SCR-RM-TECHPACK
SCREEN NAME: Raw Material Techpacks
MODULE: Product Development
WFX MENU PATH: Catalogs > Fabric / Trims > Techpack
PURPOSE: Every material the T-shirt needs is created once as its own techpack: one fabric and three trims. The BOM lines point to these article codes.
APP ROUTE: /data-model
ROUTE QUERY: doc=rm-techpack
THEORY ROUTE: /theory/rm-techpack
RELATED TRANSACTION: Raw Material Techpack (rm-techpack)
RELATED WORKFLOWS: WF-READY-STYLE-SETUP, WF-READY-END-TO-END
WORKFLOW PAGES: /workflows/style-setup, /workflows/end-to-end
SCREENSHOTS: /screens/rm-fabric-n8.webp, /screens/rm-thread-t1.webp, /screens/rm-cufflinks-ns1-1.webp, /screens/rm-polybag-pp1.webp
ACTIONS: View the documented fields and how each one gets its value; open the transaction theory; open related workflows
REQUIRED ROLE: viewer
WFX URL: 
KEYWORDS: Raw Material Techpacks, rm techpack, Raw Material Techpack
SOURCE: Knowledge Hub v1 data (src/app/data/docs.ts): screens captured from live WFX or from the owner's Excel trial.
STATUS: Active
CREATED DATE: 2026-11-18

MODULE: Product Development

SCREEN ID: SCR-MRP
SCREEN NAME: MRP
MODULE: Planning
WFX MENU PATH: Planning > MRP
PURPOSE: Level 1 = garments to make (from the OC). Level 2 = fabric to buy: garment qty × BOM final consumption. Running Level 1 for the full qty generates the child indents. Any level can take a negative, but a child indent is reduced or cancelled only by a negative at its parent level, and only after MRP is re-run.
APP ROUTE: /data-model
ROUTE QUERY: doc=mrp
THEORY ROUTE: /theory/mrp
RELATED TRANSACTION: MRP – Material Requirement Planning (mrp)
RELATED WORKFLOWS: WF-READY-BLOCK-BOOKING, WF-READY-SALES-ORDER, WF-READY-END-TO-END
WORKFLOW PAGES: /workflows/block-booking, /workflows/sales-order, /workflows/end-to-end
SCREENSHOTS: 
ACTIONS: View the documented fields and how each one gets its value; open the transaction theory; open related workflows
REQUIRED ROLE: viewer
WFX URL: 
KEYWORDS: MRP, mrp, MRP – Material Requirement Planning
SOURCE: Knowledge Hub v1 data (src/app/data/docs.ts): screens captured from live WFX or from the owner's Excel trial.
STATUS: Active
CREATED DATE: 2026-11-18

SCREEN ID: SCR-SO-ACTIONS
SCREEN NAME: Sales Order · Delivery & order actions
MODULE: Order
WFX MENU PATH: Sales Order list · context menus
PURPOSE: Add, copy, delete, split, cancel, close and reopen a delivery; cancel, close, revise or split/shuffle a whole order. Remarks are required for cancel, close and reopen, and every action is written to History.
APP ROUTE: /data-model
ROUTE QUERY: doc=so-actions
THEORY ROUTE: /theory/buyer-po
RELATED TRANSACTION: Purchase Order from Buyer (OC) (buyer-po)
